_doc: Cap'n H — the other exceptional shop leader anchoring the technician pit in Act 6. Altered from Hector. Competent, fair, and protective — a genuine leader who runs the bays on trust and skill rather than fear. He and Tani together create the only authentic workplace sanctuary the entire six-act memoir produces. Dialogue-only.
name: Cap'n H
title: Shop Team Lead
samplePhrase: This bay doesn't run on fear. It runs on the fact that we know what we're doing and we do it right.
